[Intro]
[C]
[F]

[Verse 1]
[C]Hangin' around, hittin' the ground,
dead in the water
[F]Suckin' it up, fuckin' it up,
the favorite daughter
[C]Takin' a swing, everything
goin' 'round in circles
[F]Takin' a hit, this is it,
I'm over it

[Chorus]
[C]
I can't quit
[F]
I'm over it

[Verse 2]
[C]Shutting it up, cutting me up
with broken glasses
[F]Havin' a bourb, been learning love
in evening classes
[C]Gettin' your man and go to
work out with your sister
[F]Talkin' a bit, but this it,
I'm over it

[Chorus]
[C]
I can't quit
[F]
I'm over it
[C]

[F]

[Break]
[Em]You can't change me,
[F]can you? You
can't offer that much to
[G]me Oh you
[Em]can't offer change,
[F]can you? And I
can't offer that much to
[G]you

[Verse 3]
[C]Havin' it out, livin' in doubt
with no defenses
[F]Tighten the rope, and talkin' to hope
in different tenses
[C]Callin' my friends and tellin' the
only one that answers
[F]It's hard to admit, but this it,
I'm over it
